contract.storage_dispatch: Select the smallest calibrated length region that holds sum(round_up(L_i, 2 * max_cp_size)).
contract.tail_padding: Tail padding extends the final real sequence to the requested pack boundary. It is excluded from every timing feature.
contract.timing_formula: Per geometry and storage region, T = beta_0 + sum_j beta_j standardize(x_j). Candidate x_j are functions of S1, S2, N, Lmin/Lmax/Lmean, P_A, G_A, and optional work hinges, where A=2*max_cp_size.
